title: Provincial Motor Vehicles Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Motor Vehicles Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 2001
PROVINCIAL
MOTOR VEHICLES (SECOND AMENDMENT )
ORDINANCE,
2001
ORDINANCE XXXI OF
2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles
Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette
of Punjab, Extraordinary, 25th October, 2001]
No. Legis:
13-27/98-P.I., dated 25-10-2001.----The following
Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information:
And, whereas,
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is dissolved and the Governor is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action.
Now, therefore,
in pursuance of the proclamation of fourteenth day of October, 1999 and
Provisional Constitution Order No.1 of 1999 read with Article 4 of the
Provisional Constitution-(Amendment) Order No.9 of 1999 as amended by Chief
Executive's Order No. l I of 2000 and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:--
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.----(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Punjab,
(3) It shall come into force at once
